cause: Price shocks, new ranges, changed promo response
key_controls: PSI + rolling MAPE monitoring; documented thresholds; scheduled retrain; fallback model
key_risk_indicators: Max PSI; 12-wk MAPE; days since retrain

risk: Silent model failure (stale or null inputs)
cause: Upstream feed breaks or schema changes
impact: Plausible but wrong forecasts used for allocation
key_controls: Input validation and freshness checks; hard-stop on missing features; alert to on-call
key_risk_indicators: Feature null rate; feed latency; failed validation count

key_controls: Human-in-the-loop for large changes; override logging; forecast-vs-plan challenge in S&OP
key_risk_indicators: % overrides; share of orders above tolerance auto-approved

risk: Weak change control on model releases
cause: Retrain deployed without testing or sign-off
key_controls: Model registry; champion-challenger testing; approval gate; rollback plan

risk: Third-party model / API outage or vendor change
cause: Hosted model or cloud region unavailable; model version retired
impact: Forecasts unavailable at peak; planners revert to manual
key_controls: Warm fallback (4-week-average) in own environment; vendor SLAs and exit plan; version pinning
key_risk_indicators: Fallback invocation count; vendor SLA breaches

cause: Training data contains personal data; model or data exfiltrated
key_controls: Data minimisation; access controls; DPIA; logging
key_risk_indicators: Open DPIA actions; access review exceptions

risk: Bias / unfair outcome in allocation across stores or regions
key_controls: Segment-level error reporting; fairness review at each release
key_risk_indicators: MAPE gap between best and worst segment

impact: Slow root cause after incident; weak audit trail
key_controls: Feature importance logging; reason codes for large moves; versioned data snapshots
